correctness.rationale: Independent full-generator reconstruction shows both stationary means omega/(r+gamma). Common reset gives S=sum_i X_i=0 and D_S=2A/((r+gamma)(r+2gamma)). For independent clocks, the S^2 jump generator gives E S^2=E||X||^2/2 and D_I=A(2N-1)/((r+gamma)(N r+(2N-1)gamma)). Their exact difference is A r/((r+gamma)(r+2gamma)(N r+(2N-1)gamma))>0. Contraction under coupled reset clocks and Foster quadratic drift establish finite-moment stationary uniqueness; common-mode variance is zero only in the synchronous protocol. I separately solved all full symmetric second-moment equations in 24 rational cases (two protocols each).
